cases.explain: Сион is the direct object of the imperative verb 'Проснись' (awake), and is in vocative/nominative form when directly addressed.

cases.sentence: Оденься в одежды ___! Иерусалим, святой город!
cases.explain: The prepositional phrase 'одежды величия' (garments of glory) uses the genitive case after the noun одежды.

cases.sentence: Отряхнись от пыли и поднимись! Сядь на престол, ___!
cases.explain: Иерусалим is being directly addressed in the vocative, which in Russian uses the nominative case form.
In the phrase 'дочь Сиона' (daughter of Zion), the noun Сион is in the genitive case indicating possession.

cases.sentence: Ведь так говорит Господь, даром вы были проданы, и не за деньги будете искуплены. Ведь так говорит владыка ___, вначале мой народ пошел в Египет, чтобы жить там.
cases.explain: Господь is the grammatical subject of говорит (says), so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Как прекрасны на горах ноги тех, кто несет радостную весть, возвещая ___, кто приносит добрые известия, возвещая спасение.
cases.explain: The verb возвещая (proclaiming) takes the accusative case for its direct object мир (peace).

cases.sentence: Слушай, стражи твои поднимают свои голоса и вместе кричат от радости, потому что видят своими глазами, как ___ возвращается на Сион.
cases.explain: Господь is the subject of the verb возвращается (returns), requiring the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Запевайте вместе песню радости, развалины ___. Так как Господь утешил свой народ и скупил Иерусалим.
cases.explain: In the phrase 'развалины Иерусалима' (ruins of Jerusalem), the genitive case indicates possession.

reading.ru: Проснись! Проснись, Сион! Облекись силой! Оденься в одежды великолепия!
reading.question: What is Zion being called to do in this verse?
options: Awake and put on strength and beautiful garments
reading.correct: Awake and put on strength and beautiful garments
reading.explain: The text directly commands Zion to 'Awake, awake! Put on your strength, Zion. Put on your beautiful garments.'

reading.ru: Ведь так говорит Господь, даром вы были проданы, и не за деньги будете искуплены.
reading.question: How were the people sold and how will they be redeemed according to this verse?
options: They were sold for nothing and will be redeemed without money
They were sold for a price and will be bought back with gold
They sold themselves and will buy their own freedom
They cannot be redeemed at any cost
reading.correct: They were sold for nothing and will be redeemed without money
reading.explain: The verse states 'You were sold for nothing; and you will be redeemed without money.'

reading.ru: Как прекрасны на горах ноги тех, кто несет радостную весть, возвещая мир, кто приносит добрые известия, возвещая спасение.
reading.question: What makes the feet of the messenger beautiful in this verse?
options: They bring good news, proclaim peace, and announce salvation
They wear beautiful shoes and jewelry
They travel quickly on the mountains
reading.correct: They bring good news, proclaim peace, and announce salvation
reading.explain: The passage describes how beautiful are the feet of 'him who brings good news, who proclaims peace, who brings good news, who proclaims salvation.'

reading.ru: Слушай, стражи твои поднимают свои голоса и вместе кричат от радости, потому что видят своими глазами, как Господь возвращается на Сион.
reading.question: Why do the watchmen cry out with joy?
options: They see with their own eyes that the Lord returns to Zion
They receive payment for their work
They are celebrating a military victory
They are singing a traditional song
reading.correct: They see with their own eyes that the Lord returns to Zion
reading.explain: The text says the watchmen shout for joy 'because they see with their own eyes, how the Lord returns to Zion.'

reading.ru: Уходите! Уходите! Выходите оттуда! Не прикасайтесь к нечистому.
reading.question: What are the people being commanded to do?
options: Leave that place and not touch anything unclean
Stay and wait for further instructions
reading.correct: Leave that place and not touch anything unclean
reading.explain: The command is 'Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing!'

reading.ru: Вот слуга мой будет преуспевать, он будет возвышен, вознесен и возвеличен.
reading.question: What is promised about God's servant?
options: The servant will prosper, be exalted and greatly praised
The servant will suffer and be rejected
The servant will become a slave to others
The servant will disappear and never be seen again
reading.correct: The servant will prosper, be exalted and greatly praised
reading.explain: The verse states 'Behold, my servant will deal wisely. He will be exalted and lifted up, and will be very high.'
